title: Canonical coefficient comparison on the coherent Cech total
statement:
Let $\mathcal X,\mathcal Y$ be topoi presented by small sites in fixed larger coefficient universes [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention], with sheaves of commutative rings $R_X,R_Y$ and module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $f:(\mathcal X,R_X)\to(\mathcal Y,R_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism] with Cartesian coefficient identification and exact module inverse image. Let $V\to1_{\mathcal X}$ be an epimorphism of sheaves of sets, $V_n=V^{\times(n+1)}$, and $v_n:\mathcal X/V_n\to\mathcal X$ the slice localizations with rings $v_n^*R_X$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. All diagrams are small. Use ordinary unbounded module derived categories with localization functor $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and finite-diagonal total complexes with differential $d_{\mathrm{Cech}}+(-1)^n d_I$ in Cech degree $n$ [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Give the same underlying topoi also coefficient sheaves $R'_X,R'_Y$ and a ringed morphism $f':(\mathcal X,R'_X)\to(\mathcal Y,R'_Y)$ with the same underlying geometric morphism and Cartesian coefficients; write $v'_n$ for the same slice localizations with localized $R'_X$. Let $\varphi_X:R'_X\to R_X$ and $\varphi_Y:R'_Y\to R_Y$ be morphisms of sheaves of rings compatible with the coefficient maps of $f$ and $f'$: the two ring maps $f^{-1}R'_Y\to R_X$, through $f^{-1}\varphi_Y$ followed by the coefficient map of $f$ and through the coefficient map of $f'$ followed by $\varphi_X$, agree. Let $T_X:\operatorname{Mod}(R_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R'_X)$, $T_Y:\operatorname{Mod}(R_Y)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R'_Y)$, and $T_n:\operatorname{Mod}(v_n^*R_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(v_n^*R'_X)$ be restriction of scalars along $\varphi_X$, $\varphi_Y$ and $v_n^*\varphi_X$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]; they are exact. Use their canonical commutation identifications $T_Y f_*\cong f'_*T_X$, $T_n v_n^*\cong v_n'^*T_X$, and $T_X v_{n*}\cong v'_{n*}T_n$: these are the identities on underlying sheaves of abelian groups given by actual scalar restriction, compatible with restriction maps and localization units and counits. Let $a:K[0]\to I$ be a nonnegative injective resolution for $R_X$, and $c:T_XK[0]\to J$ one for $R'_X$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Set $B_V(I)^{n,q}=(fv_n)_*v_n^*I^q$, $B'_V(J)^{n,q}=(f'v'_n)_*v_n'^*J^q$, with their unit augmentations $b_I,b'_J$. Write $e_I:Q(f_*I)\cong Rf_*(K[0])$ and $e_J:Q(f'_*J)\cong Rf'_*(T_XK[0])$ for the canonical comparisons, and $D(T_Y)$ for termwise exact descent to derived categories [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. There exists a chain map $t:T_XI\to J$ with $Q(t)Q(T_Xa)=Q(c)$, unique up to chain homotopy. It induces the bicomplex map $\beta_t:T_Y B_V(I)\to B'_V(J)$ and the finite-total map $\overline\beta_t:T_Y\operatorname{Tot}B_V(I)\to\operatorname{Tot}B'_V(J)$. If $\gamma_f:D(T_Y)Rf_*\to Rf'_*D(T_X)$ is the canonical right-derived coefficient comparison of [lem-sfb-exact-square-right-derived-unit] for $F=f_*$, $G=f'_*$, $U=T_X$, $V=T_Y$ and the commutation identification $T_Yf_*\cong f'_*T_X$, then
$$Q(\overline\beta_t)D(T_Y)(Q(b_I)e_I^{-1})=(Q(b'_J)e_J^{-1})\gamma_f(K[0]).$$
Here the canonical finite-biproduct comparison identifies $D(T_Y)Q(\operatorname{Tot}B_V(I))$ with $Q(T_Y\operatorname{Tot}B_V(I))$. In every column $\beta_t$ represents the corresponding canonical comparison for $fv_n$, defined by the right-derived unit at $T_n v_n^*I$ followed by the resolution comparison. The equation and all these derived maps are independent of $t$ and compatible with refinement. No preservation of injectives by the $T$ functors, and no invertibility of $\gamma_f$ or its column comparisons, is assumed.

proof.text: Exact scalar restriction preserves the nonnegative resolution quasi-isomorphism. After extension by zero, represent Q(c) Q(Ta) inverse by a chain map using the K-injective Hom bijection [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]. Fullness of extension restricts the chain map and its homotopy to nonnegative complexes. Cancellation of Q(Ta) and faithfulness on homotopy classes prove uniqueness.

Use the separate strict construction [lem-sfb-cech-coefficient-strict-maps] on the two resolutions. It supplies the specified bicomplex and finite-total maps, the unit augmentations and their chain square, homotopy invariance and actual cover-refinement equations.

Module sheaves are Grothendieck abelian by the proved source-library theorem SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian; hence they have K-injective resolutions. An additive functor sends homotopy equivalences between K-injectives to homotopy equivalences, so it derives on the K-injective right-derivability structure. Thus any supplied right-derived pair has invertible unit on a K-injective complex. Define each normalized resolution comparison as the unit followed by the inverse derived resolution map. The universal property also constructs the column derived pairs and their comparison satisfying the specified unit equation [def-sfb-right-derived-functor].

For general F,G,U,V and any comparison satisfying the unit equation, cancel the normalized source comparison and the derived image of the target resolution. Naturality of the comparison, exact-functor factorization and the target unit, together with Q(Ua) Q(t)=Q(c), give the resolution comparison equation. Apply Q to the strict augmentation square, and use naturality of the exact descent factorization at b to obtain the total equation.

The existing column model [lem-sfb-cech-injective-column-model] supplies K-injective localized resolutions and localized quasi-isomorphisms. The actual element-site pullback has both adjoints, hence is exact. Transport the lift equation through this exact functor and the componentwise pullback-scalar isomorphism. Apply the general comparison calculation to each localized column. Finally feed uniqueness up to homotopy into the strict invariance result; keep the strict refinement squares.

theorem cech_coefficient_derived_comparison
    {C Y : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory Y]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {L : GrothendieckTopology Y}
    (R R' : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}) (S S' : Sheaf L RingCat.{u})
    (_hR : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x y : R.obj.obj U), x * y = y * x)
    (_hR' : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x y : R'.obj.obj U), x * y = y * x)
    (_hS : ∀ (U : Yᵒᵖ) (x y : S.obj.obj U), x * y = y * x)
    (_hS' : ∀ (U : Yᵒᵖ) (x y : S'.obj.obj U), x * y = y * x)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (ringedSiteModules.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wXp} (ringedSiteModules.{u} R')]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (ringedSiteModules.{u} S)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wYp} (ringedSiteModules.{u} S')]
    [∀ A : Sheaf J (Type u),
      HasDerivedCategory.{wS} (ringedSiteModules.{u} (elementRing R A))]
    [∀ A : Sheaf J (Type u),
      HasDerivedCategory.{wSp} (ringedSiteModules.{u} (elementRing R' A))]
    (f : RingedToposMorphism R S) (f' : RingedToposMorphism R' S')
    [IsIso f.ringMap] [IsIso f'.ringMap]
    (fInverse : ringedSiteModules.{u} S ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} R)
    (fInverse' : ringedSiteModules.{u} S' ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} R')
    [fInverse.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits fInverse]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits fInverse]
    [fInverse'.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits fInverse']
    [PreservesFiniteColimits fInverse']
    (_adj : fInverse ⊣ f.modules) (_adj' : fInverse' ⊣ f'.modules)
    (hi : f.inverse = f'.inverse) (hd : f.direct = f'.direct)
    (φ : R' ⟶ R) (ψ : S' ⟶ S)
    (_coefficient_square :
      f.inverse.map ((sheafCompose L (forget RingCat)).map ψ) ≫ f.ringMap =
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun G ↦ G.obj ((sheafCompose L (forget RingCat)).obj S')) hi) ≫
          f'.ringMap ≫ (sheafCompose J (forget RingCat)).map φ)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} φ)]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} φ)]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} ψ)]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} ψ)]
    [∀ A : Sheaf J (Type u), PreservesFiniteLimits
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} (cechCoefficientRingMap φ A))]
    [∀ A : Sheaf J (Type u), PreservesFiniteColimits
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} (cechCoefficientRingMap φ A))]
    (D : CoherentCechImageModel R) (D' : CoherentCechImageModel R')
    (E : CechCoefficientCommutations f f' φ ψ hd D D')
    (RF : CechCoefficientDerivedPair f.modules)
    (RG : CechCoefficientDerivedPair f'.modules)
    (γ : RF.functor ⋙ (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ψ).mapDerivedCategory ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars φ).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ RG.functor)
    (_hγ : CechCoefficientUnitEquation f.modules f'.modules
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars φ) (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ψ) E.base RF RG γ)
    (M : ringedSiteModules.{u} R) (I : InjectiveResolution M)
    (I' : InjectiveResolution ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars φ).obj M)) :
    (∃ t : (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ I'.cocomplex,
      IsCechCoefficientResolutionLift φ M I I' t) ∧
    (∀ t₀ t₁ : (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ I'.cocomplex,
      IsCechCoefficientResolutionLift φ M I I' t₀ →
      IsCechCoefficientResolutionLift φ M I I' t₁ → Nonempty (Homotopy t₀ t₁)) ∧
    ∃ (maps : ∀ (V : Sheaf J (Type u))
        (t : (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ I'.cocomplex),
        CechCoefficientMapData E V I.cocomplex I'.cocomplex t)
      (b : ∀ V : Sheaf J (Type u),
        (f.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶
          (D.bicomplex f.modules V I.cocomplex).total (.up ℕ))
      (b' : ∀ V : Sheaf J (Type u),
        (f'.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I'.cocomplex ⟶
          (D'.bicomplex f'.modules V I'.cocomplex).total (.up ℕ))
      (eI : DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((f.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (I.cocomplex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) ≅
        RF.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((CochainComplex.single₀ _).obj M).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)))
      (eJ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((f'.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (I'.cocomplex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) ≅
        RG.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((CochainComplex.single₀ _).obj M).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)))),
      IsCechResolutionComparison f.modules RF
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap I.ι ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) eI ∧
      IsCechResolutionComparison f'.modules RG
        (cechCoefficientResolutionAugmentation φ M I') eJ ∧
      (∀ V : Sheaf J (Type u), D.IsAugmentation f.modules V I.cocomplex (b V) ∧
        D'.IsAugmentation f'.modules V I'.cocomplex (b' V)) ∧
      (∀ (V : Sheaf J (Type u)) (_hV : Epi (terminal.from V))
        (t : (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ I'.cocomplex),
        IsCechCoefficientResolutionLift φ M I I' t →
        (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ψ).mapDerivedCategory.map
            (eI.inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (cechCoefficientExtendMap f.modules (b V))) ≫
          (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ψ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
            (D.total f.modules V I.cocomplex) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (cechCoefficientExtendMap
            (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ψ) (maps V t).total) =
        γ.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((CochainComplex.single₀ _).obj M).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) ≫
          RG.functor.map ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
            (((CochainComplex.single₀ _).obj M).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) ≫
          eJ.inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (cechCoefficientExtendMap f'.modules (b' V))) ∧
      (∀ (V : Sheaf J (Type u)) (_hV : Epi (terminal.from V))
        (t : (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ I'.cocomplex)
        (_ht : IsCechCoefficientResolutionLift φ M I I' t) (n : SimplexCategory),
        IsCechCoefficientColumnComparison
          (D.push ((sheafCoverNerve V).obj (op n)) ⋙ f.modules)
          (D'.push ((sheafCoverNerve V).obj (op n)) ⋙ f'.modules)
          (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (cechCoefficientRingMap φ ((sheafCoverNerve V).obj (op n))))
          (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ψ) (E.column ((sheafCoverNerve V).obj (op n)))
          ((cechColumnRestrictComplex D ((sheafCoverNerve V).obj (op n))).map
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap I.ι ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
          ((cechCoefficientPullComplexIso E ((sheafCoverNerve V).obj (op n))
              (((CochainComplex.single₀ _).obj M).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).hom ≫
            (cechColumnRestrictComplex D' ((sheafCoverNerve V).obj (op n))).map
              (cechCoefficientResolutionAugmentation φ M I'))
          (cechCoefficientLocalizedMap E ((sheafCoverNerve V).obj (op n))
            (cechCoefficientLiftExtend φ t))) ∧
      (∀ (V : Sheaf J (Type u)) (t₀ t₁ :
          (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ I'.cocomplex),
        IsCechCoefficientResolutionLift φ M I I' t₀ →
        IsCechCoefficientResolutionLift φ M I I' t₁ →
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (maps V t₀).total
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (maps V t₁).total
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
            ((maps V t₀).bicomplex.f n) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
            ((maps V t₁).bicomplex.f n) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) ∧
      (∀ (V W : Sheaf J (Type u)) (r : W ⟶ V)
        (t : (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ I'.cocomplex),
        (cechCoefficientComplex ψ (.up ℕ)).map
            (D.totalRefinement f.modules r I.cocomplex) ≫ (maps W t).total =
          (maps V t).total ≫ D'.totalRefinement f'.modules r I'.cocomplex ∧
        ∀ n q : ℕ,
          (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ψ).map (f.modules.map
              ((D.image.map (((Arrow.mapCechNerve
                (Arrow.homMk r (𝟙 _) (terminal.hom_ext _ _) :
                  Arrow.mk (terminal.from W) ⟶ Arrow.mk (terminal.from V))).app
                  (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).op)).app (I.cocomplex.X q))) ≫
            ((maps W t).bicomplex.f n).f q =
          ((maps V t).bicomplex.f n).f q ≫ f'.modules.map
            ((D'.image.map (((Arrow.mapCechNerve
              (Arrow.homMk r (𝟙 _) (terminal.hom_ext _ _) :
                  Arrow.mk (terminal.from W) ⟶ Arrow.mk (terminal.from V))).app
                (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).op)).app (I'.cocomplex.X q)))
